info.name: SIDIS – Entrega 2 Modo B (Docker)
info.description:
AISafe Entrega 2 (CQRS + AMQP/RabbitMQ + Database-per-Service), Modo B: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker-compose.secure.yml up --build -d.  
Entry through the gateways [https://localhost:8443](https://localhost:8443) and [https://localhost:8444](https://localhost:8444). Use the SIDIS environment (gateway, gateway2, realm, clientId, pwd\*). Turn off SSL verification (or newman --insecure).  
Role tag in each request name: {ADMIN} {ATCC} {BACKOFFICE} {TECH} {SUPERVISOR} {NONE}.  
Folders 00 to 04 and 06: automatic (Runner / Newman). They write on one gateway and read on the other and poll until the other instance converges (eventual consistency). Airports reads carry X-P2P-Hops: 1 so that a 200 proves the event arrived through RabbitMQ and not through P2P forwarding.  
Folder 07: MANUAL; run the docker command between \[ \] before sending each request.

Flight Operations additions: 02.06–02.08 (concurrency, out-of-order event, rapid commands), 04.01–04.05 (Aircraft events published through the RabbitMQ management API: environment variables rabbitMgmt, rabbitUser, rabbitPassword) and 07.05–07.14 (manual: broker, partition, snapshot, Keycloak DB).

item.name: 02.06 Concurrency: 8 simultaneous bookings of the same slot converge to exactly one flight {NONE}

exec: const L = eval(pm.collectionVariables.get('lib'));
const asList = j => Array.isArray(j) ? j : (j && j._embedded ? [].concat(...Object.values(j._embedded)) : []);
const day = pm.environment.get('p2day3'), slot = day + 'T19:00';
const tk = await L.tok('ATCC');

const one = () => L.send({url: pm.environment.get('gateway') + '/api/scheduled-flights', method: 'POST', header: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + tk}, body: {mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({routeId: 'RT-OPOLIS', registrationNumber: 'CS-TTA', scheduledDateTime: slot + ':00'})}});
const res = await Promise.all(Array.from({length: 8}, one));
const codes = res.map(r => r.code); console.log('codes', JSON.stringify(codes));
pm.test('8 simultaneous bookings of CS-TTA for the same slot: only 201 or 409 (' + codes.join(',') + ')', () => codes.forEach(c => pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(c)));
pm.test('At most one booking accepted per replica (row lock on the aircraft)', () => pm.expect(codes.filter(c => c === 201).length).to.be.within(1, 2));
let alive = [], seen = 0;

for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) { const r = await L.call('GET', '/api/scheduled-flights/aircraft/CS-TTA', null, 'ATCC'); const at = asList(r.code === 200 ? r.json() : []).filter(f => String(f.scheduledDateTime).startsWith(slot)); alive = at.filter(f => f.status !== 'CANCELED'); const canceled = at.filter(f => f.status === 'CANCELED'); if (alive.length === 1 && canceled.every(f => /^SCHEDULE_CONFLICT_WITH/.test(f.statusReason || ''))) { seen++; if (seen >= 4) break; } else seen = 0; await L.sleep(500); }

pm.test('After convergence, exactly ONE flight remains at ' + slot + ' on every replica (double booking compensated)', () => { pm.expect(alive.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(seen).to.be.at.least(4); });
// Own dates for these tests (do not collide with the dates of folders 02 and 03).
const base = Date.UTC(2031 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8), Math.floor(Math.random() * 12), 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 25));
[0, 1, 2, 3].forEach(i => pm.environment.set('p2day' + i, new Date(base + i * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10)));

item.name: 02.07 Out-of-order event: a stale FlightStatusChanged (revision 1) is ignored by both replicas {NONE}

exec: const L = eval(pm.collectionVariables.get('lib'));
const MG = pm.environment.get('rabbitMgmt') || 'http://localhost:15672';
const AUTH = 'Basic ' + btoa(pm.environment.get('rabbitUser') + ':' + pm.environment.get('rabbitPassword'));
const id = pm.environment.get('e2FlightId');
const cur = (await L.call('GET', '/api/scheduled-flights/' + id, null, 'ATCC')).json();
pm.test('Precondition: the flight is DELAYED at revision 2 (02.04)', () => { pm.expect(cur.status).to.eql('DELAYED'); pm.expect(cur.revision).to.eql(2); });

const flight = {flightId: id, routeId: cur.routeId, registrationNumber: cur.registrationNumber, scheduledDateTime: cur.scheduledDateTime, actualDepartureDateTime: null, actualArrivalDateTime: null, status: 'SCHEDULED', statusReason: null, revision: 1, lastModifiedAt: '2020-01-01T00:00:00Z', createdAt: '2020-01-01T00:00:00Z', originInstance: 'postman'};
const eid = 'p2-stale-' + Date.now();

const event = {eventId: eid, type: 'FlightStatusChanged', version: 1, occurredAt: '2020-01-01T00:00:00Z', aggregateId: id, revision: 1, sourceInstance: 'postman', correlationId: eid, payload: {previousStatus: 'DELAYED', flight}};

const p = await L.send({url: MG + '/api/exchanges/%2F/flights.events/publish', method: 'POST', header: {Authorization: AUTH, 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: {mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({properties: {content_type: 'application/json', message_id: eid}, routing_key: 'flight.status-changed', payload: JSON.stringify(event), payload_encoding: 'string'})}});
pm.test('Stale FlightStatusChanged (revision 1, SCHEDULED) published to both replicas', () => pm.expect(p.json().routed).to.eql(true));
await L.sleep(4000);
const reads = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const r = await L.call('GET', '/api/scheduled-flights/' + id, null, 'ATCC'); reads.push(r.json()); }

pm.test('Out-of-order event is ignored on both replicas: still DELAYED, revision 2 (last-writer-wins by revision)', () => reads.forEach(j => { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('DELAYED'); pm.expect(j.revision).to.eql(2); }));

request.description: Publishes directly in RabbitMQ through the management API (environment variables rabbitMgmt, rabbitUser, rabbitPassword).

item.name: 02.08 Rapid command sequence across replicas (DELAYED → IN_FLIGHT → COMPLETED) converges {NONE}

exec: const L = eval(pm.collectionVariables.get('lib'));
const r0 = await L.call('POST', '/api/scheduled-flights', {routeId: 'RT-OPOLIS', registrationNumber: 'CS-TTA', scheduledDateTime: pm.environment.get('p2day3') + 'T11:00:00'}, 'ATCC');
pm.test('Flight created (201)', () => pm.expect(r0.code).to.eql(201));
const id = r0.json().id;
const steps = ['DELAYED', 'IN_FLIGHT', 'COMPLETED'];

for (const s of steps) { let r; for (let k = 0; k < 15; k++) { r = await L.call('PATCH', '/api/scheduled-flights/' + id + '/status', {status: s}, 'ATCC'); if (r.code === 200) break; await L.sleep(300); } pm.test('Command ' + s + ' accepted by one of the replicas (200)', () => pm.expect(r.code).to.eql(200)); }
let last = [];

for (let k = 0; k < 30; k++) { last = []; for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { const r = await L.call('GET', '/api/scheduled-flights/' + id, null, 'ATCC'); if (r.code === 200) last.push(r.json()); } if (last.length === 6 && last.every(j => j.status === 'COMPLETED') && new Set(last.map(j => j.revision)).size === 1) break; await L.sleep(500); }

pm.test('Rapid command sequence converges: both replicas show COMPLETED with the same revision', () => { pm.expect(last.length).to.eql(6); pm.expect(last.every(j => j.status === 'COMPLETED')).to.be.true; pm.expect(new Set(last.map(j => j.revision)).size).to.eql(1); });
const fin = await L.call('PATCH', '/api/scheduled-flights/' + id + '/status', {status: 'CANCELED'}, 'ATCC');
pm.test('A COMPLETED flight cannot be canceled on any replica (409)', () => pm.expect(fin.code).to.eql(409));

item.name: 02.09 [FO query] Flights of CS-TTA: the new flight is listed, no duplicates {ATCC} → 200

item.name: 04 Aircraft events to Flight Operations (AMQP)
04.01 Register a test aircraft and schedule 3 flights on it {NONE}

exec: const L = eval(pm.collectionVariables.get('lib'));
const reg = 'CS-U' + (1000 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 9000)); pm.environment.set('testReg', reg);
const at = h => new Date(Date.now() + h * 3600000).toISOString().slice(0, 19);
const reg1 = await L.call('POST', '/api/aircraft-models/instances', {registrationNumber: reg, modelName: 'A320', manufacturingDate: '2020-01-01', seatingCapacity: 180, features: 'test'}, 'ATCC');
pm.test('[Aircraft] ' + reg + ' registered (201)', () => pm.expect(reg1.code).to.eql(201));
const ids = [];

for (const h of [3, 6, 9]) { let r; for (let k = 0; k < 10; k++) { r = await L.call('POST', '/api/scheduled-flights', {routeId: 'RT-OPOLIS', registrationNumber: reg, scheduledDateTime: at(h)}, 'ATCC'); if (r.code === 201) break; await L.sleep(1000); } pm.test('Flight in ' + h + ' h scheduled on ' + reg + ' (201)', () => pm.expect(r.code).to.eql(201)); if (r.code === 201) ids.push(r.json().id); }

item.name: 04.02 [Aircraft events] AircraftStatusChanged (UNDER_MAINTENANCE) via fo.grounding: flights moved, aircraft UNDER_MAINTENANCE {NONE}

exec: const L = eval(pm.collectionVariables.get('lib'));
const asList = j => Array.isArray(j) ? j : (j && j._embedded ? [].concat(...Object.values(j._embedded)) : []);
const MG = pm.environment.get('rabbitMgmt') || 'http://localhost:15672';
const AUTH = 'Basic ' + btoa(pm.environment.get('rabbitUser') + ':' + pm.environment.get('rabbitPassword'));
const mgmt = (m, p, b) => L.send({url: MG + p, method: m, header: {'Authorization': AUTH, 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: b ? {mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify(b)} : undefined});

const publish = (rk, eventId, payload) => mgmt('POST', '/api/exchanges/%2F/aircraft.events/publish', {properties: {content_type: 'application/json', message_id: eventId}, routing_key: rk, payload: typeof payload === 'string' ? payload : JSON.stringify(payload), payload_encoding: 'string'});

const ev = (eid, reg, status, rev) => ({eventId: eid, type: 'AircraftStatusChanged', occurredAt: new Date().toISOString(), aggregateId: reg, revision: rev, payload: {registrationNumber: reg, status: status}});

const statusOf = async reg => { const r = await L.call('GET', '/api/scheduled-flights/availability?registrationNumber=' + reg + '&dateTime=' + new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 19), null, 'ATCC'); return r.code === 200 ? r.json() : {}; };

const stableStatus = async (reg, pred) => { let ok = 0, u = {}; for (let k = 0; k < 30 && ok < 4; k++) { u = await statusOf(reg); ok = pred(u) ? ok + 1 : 0; if (ok < 4) await L.sleep(500); } return {u, ok: ok >= 4}; };

pm.test('RabbitMQ management credentials are set in the environment (rabbitUser, rabbitPassword)', () => { pm.expect(pm.environment.get('rabbitUser')).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(pm.environment.get('rabbitPassword')).to.be.a('string'); });
const reg = pm.environment.get('testReg');
pm.test('Run 04.01 first (it creates the test aircraft ' + reg + ')', () => pm.expect(reg).to.be.a('string'));
const before = await L.call('GET', '/api/scheduled-flights/aircraft/' + reg, null, 'ATCC');
const mine = asList(before.code === 200 ? before.json() : []).filter(f => ['SCHEDULED', 'DELAYED'].includes(f.status)).map(f => f.id);
pm.environment.set('groundIds', JSON.stringify(mine));
const eid = 'p2-ground-' + Date.now(); pm.environment.set('groundEventId', eid);
const p = await publish('aircraft.status-changed', eid, ev(eid, reg, 'UNDER_MAINTENANCE', 100));
pm.test('Event published and routed by the broker', () => { pm.expect(p.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(p.json().routed).to.eql(true); });
let moved = [];

for (let k = 0; k < 30; k++) { moved = []; for (const id of mine) { const r = await L.call('GET', '/api/scheduled-flights/' + id, null, 'ATCC'); const j = r.json(); if (r.code === 200 && (j.registrationNumber !== reg || j.statusReason === 'NO_REPLACEMENT_AIRCRAFT')) moved.push(j); } if (moved.length === mine.length) break; await L.sleep(500); }

pm.test('Every future flight of ' + reg + ' (' + mine.length + ') was reassigned or delayed with NO_REPLACEMENT_AIRCRAFT', () => { pm.expect(mine.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(moved.length).to.eql(mine.length); });
pm.environment.set('groundRevisions', JSON.stringify(moved.map(j => j.revision)));
const s = await stableStatus(reg, u => u.aircraftStatus === 'UNDER_MAINTENANCE');
pm.test(reg + ' is UNDER_MAINTENANCE on both replicas (aircraft_ref updated by the event)', () => pm.expect(s.ok).to.be.true);

request.description: Publishes directly in RabbitMQ through the management API (environment variables rabbitMgmt, rabbitUser, rabbitPassword). Uses the aircraft created in 04.06.

item.name: 04.03 [Aircraft events] Duplicate event (same eventId) changes nothing: idempotent consumers {NONE}

exec: const L = eval(pm.collectionVariables.get('lib'));
const MG = pm.environment.get('rabbitMgmt') || 'http://localhost:15672';
const AUTH = 'Basic ' + btoa(pm.environment.get('rabbitUser') + ':' + pm.environment.get('rabbitPassword'));
const mgmt = (m, p, b) => L.send({url: MG + p, method: m, header: {'Authorization': AUTH, 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: b ? {mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify(b)} : undefined});

const publish = (rk, eventId, payload) => mgmt('POST', '/api/exchanges/%2F/aircraft.events/publish', {properties: {content_type: 'application/json', message_id: eventId}, routing_key: rk, payload: typeof payload === 'string' ? payload : JSON.stringify(payload), payload_encoding: 'string'});

const ev = (eid, reg, status, rev) => ({eventId: eid, type: 'AircraftStatusChanged', occurredAt: new Date().toISOString(), aggregateId: reg, revision: rev, payload: {registrationNumber: reg, status: status}});

const statusOf = async reg => { const r = await L.call('GET', '/api/scheduled-flights/availability?registrationNumber=' + reg + '&dateTime=' + new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 19), null, 'ATCC'); return r.code === 200 ? r.json() : {}; };

const stableStatus = async (reg, pred) => { let ok = 0, u = {}; for (let k = 0; k < 30 && ok < 4; k++) { u = await statusOf(reg); ok = pred(u) ? ok + 1 : 0; if (ok < 4) await L.sleep(500); } return {u, ok: ok >= 4}; };
const reg = pm.environment.get('testReg'), eid = pm.environment.get('groundEventId');
const ids = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get('groundIds') || '[]'), revs = JSON.parse(pm.environment.get('groundRevisions') || '[]');
const p = await publish('aircraft.status-changed', eid, ev(eid, reg, 'UNDER_MAINTENANCE', 100));
pm.test('Same event (same eventId) published again', () => pm.expect(p.json().routed).to.eql(true));
await L.sleep(4000);
const now = [];
for (const id of ids) { const r = await L.call('GET', '/api/scheduled-flights/' + id, null, 'ATCC'); now.push(r.json().revision); }
pm.test('Duplicate event changes nothing: same revisions ' + JSON.stringify(revs), () => pm.expect(now).to.eql(revs));

item.name: 04.04 [Aircraft events] Older event ignored, newer event applied (revision order) {NONE}

exec: const L = eval(pm.collectionVariables.get('lib'));
const MG = pm.environment.get('rabbitMgmt') || 'http://localhost:15672';
const AUTH = 'Basic ' + btoa(pm.environment.get('rabbitUser') + ':' + pm.environment.get('rabbitPassword'));
const mgmt = (m, p, b) => L.send({url: MG + p, method: m, header: {'Authorization': AUTH, 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: b ? {mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify(b)} : undefined});

const publish = (rk, eventId, payload) => mgmt('POST', '/api/exchanges/%2F/aircraft.events/publish', {properties: {content_type: 'application/json', message_id: eventId}, routing_key: rk, payload: typeof payload === 'string' ? payload : JSON.stringify(payload), payload_encoding: 'string'});

const ev = (eid, reg, status, rev) => ({eventId: eid, type: 'AircraftStatusChanged', occurredAt: new Date().toISOString(), aggregateId: reg, revision: rev, payload: {registrationNumber: reg, status: status}});

const statusOf = async reg => { const r = await L.call('GET', '/api/scheduled-flights/availability?registrationNumber=' + reg + '&dateTime=' + new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 19), null, 'ATCC'); return r.code === 200 ? r.json() : {}; };

const stableStatus = async (reg, pred) => { let ok = 0, u = {}; for (let k = 0; k < 30 && ok < 4; k++) { u = await statusOf(reg); ok = pred(u) ? ok + 1 : 0; if (ok < 4) await L.sleep(500); } return {u, ok: ok >= 4}; };
const reg = pm.environment.get('testReg');
const old = 'p2-old-' + Date.now();
await publish('aircraft.status-changed', old, ev(old, reg, 'ACTIVE', 50));
await L.sleep(4000);
const a = await stableStatus(reg, u => u.aircraftStatus === 'UNDER_MAINTENANCE');
pm.test('An OLDER event (revision 50 < 100) is ignored: ' + reg + ' stays UNDER_MAINTENANCE', () => pm.expect(a.ok).to.be.true);
const nw = 'p2-new-' + Date.now();
await publish('aircraft.status-changed', nw, ev(nw, reg, 'ACTIVE', 101));
const b = await stableStatus(reg, u => u.aircraftStatus === 'ACTIVE');
pm.test('A NEWER event (revision 101) is applied: ' + reg + ' is ACTIVE again (' + b.u.aircraftStatus + ')', () => pm.expect(b.ok).to.be.true);
